digest.title: NIST Project Aims to Accelerate Mobile Driver’s License Adoption
digest.summary: Mobile driver’s licenses could help U.S. citizens do business more securely, but there are few ways to use them — an issue the project is designed to help address.

digest.title: NASA Science
digest.summary: On November 24, all denizens of our fair planet could watch the Moon rise opposite the setting Sun. Easy to spot in twilight skies above fields, fences, backyards, and even stone walls, the Moon was big and bright, and at its full phase. Known to some as a Beaver Moon, November's Full Moon was also near perigee, the closest point in its elliptical orbit…
